poems.title: Out of Life
poems.note: The Severn, 701 Cathedral St — the tower; the fall runs north to the Belvedere

set_pieces.name: The reading
set_pieces.camera: static wide of the bare room, POET in the foreground, window and EX's back deep in frame; insert on the TV

set_pieces.name: Haze at the window
set_pieces.line: i look for a way out
set_pieces.camera: slow push toward the window that never closes the distance (dolly-zoom feel), haze softening focus

set_pieces.name: Off the fire escape
set_pieces.camera: over-the-railing high angle as the EX drops, then POV fall through cloud to black; hold black for title

set_pieces.name: The fall montage
set_pieces.camera: top-down falling bodies with projected/composited imagery streaming past; EX always seen from behind

set_pieces.name: Crashing the vintage party
set_pieces.camera: handheld through the crowd at overcranked speed, light leaks, EX glimpsed back-to-camera then gone

set_pieces.name: Hole in the floor
set_pieces.line: as I stumble / on my own words,
set_pieces.camera: low floor-level angle on his feet catching the edge, then overhead as he drops away into black

poems.title: Flashing Lights
poems.note: the road winding down into the Jones Falls valley

set_pieces.name: Falling with headlights off
set_pieces.line: I heard a / scream for help
set_pieces.camera: floating wide in a black stage, strobing practicals; EX kept back-to-camera at a fixed unreachable distance

set_pieces.name: Eyes dilate
set_pieces.line: an emergency call / while tossing & turning—
set_pieces.camera: extreme close-up on the POET's eye, pupil opening, macro push-through into the next scene

set_pieces.name: Car pulls up
set_pieces.line: Heart break revisits / an old scene.
set_pieces.camera: from behind the child at the window, headlight beams sweeping across walls and ceiling

set_pieces.name: The ghost child
set_pieces.line: the ghost of a dead / & a love-less / seven-year old child
set_pieces.camera: soft two-shot at child height, ghost slightly diffused; frost breath on the windowpane insert

set_pieces.name: Parents arguing in the car
set_pieces.line: a child is left / home alone
set_pieces.camera: over-the-shoulder through the glass to the lit car interior; reverse close-up on the child's face in headlight wash

set_pieces.name: Tambourine through the window
set_pieces.camera: high-speed glass shatter from outside looking in, tambourine exiting toward camera

poems.place: The Childhood Window on the Road Winding Down

poems.title: How to Break off an Engagement
poems.note: the island the bay took — no building left standing (OSM: 0)

set_pieces.name: Tambourine through the chapel window
set_pieces.camera: tracking with the tumbling tambourine in black, then a clean pass through the window into the nave

set_pieces.name: The empty temple
set_pieces.camera: locked-off time-lapse plates and macro close-ups on wood, stone and web

set_pieces.name: Gifts at the side doors
set_pieces.camera: low exterior angle on the threshold, time-lapse of boxes weathering

set_pieces.name: The storm
set_pieces.camera: wide exterior time-lapse of the chapel silhouette in lightning, pulling back as it is washed away

set_pieces.name: Remnants on the shore

set_pieces.name: Tambourine shatters
set_pieces.camera: slow-motion ground-level impact, fragments scattering toward lens

poems.title: Nevermore
poems.note: the night beach, dunes up from the surf

set_pieces.name: Shore of broken pieces
set_pieces.line: What if i followed this / trail
set_pieces.camera: lateral tracking along the tide line, POET in silhouette, ravens crossing; hands never shown

set_pieces.name: The silence
set_pieces.line: the waves will / calm to folded whispers
set_pieces.camera: locked-off wides of sea and tree line, minimal motion

set_pieces.name: The heart on the sand
set_pieces.camera: low angle from the sand up past the glowing heart to the POET's chest; it rises into frame and in

set_pieces.name: Trail up the incline
set_pieces.line: the midlife / corner we turn toward / the incline—
set_pieces.camera: crane or drone rising with him up the dune path, sea dropping behind

set_pieces.name: Night garden field
set_pieces.line: into the vast moonlit / night's / garden fields.
set_pieces.camera: wide moonlit field with the POET small in rows; reverse on blooms turning toward lens

set_pieces.name: Searching for hands
set_pieces.camera: near-black low-key shots skimming bare soil; payoff close-up as the hands return (first time hands are seen)

set_pieces.name: Standing in the field
set_pieces.camera: static frontal medium-wide, still tree and field behind; slow push in

poems.place: Ruins Shore and the Night Garden Fields

poems.title: Bloodline
poems.note: the plain beside the Avenue of the Dead — the ancestors' parade

set_pieces.name: The field goes still
set_pieces.line: They tell me to ask if I can inherit the earth
set_pieces.camera: wide static on the field at night, POET small at center, procession lights entering from the far edge

set_pieces.name: Naming stars
set_pieces.camera: medium tracking alongside POET as he walks into the parade; inserts of hands passing points of light

set_pieces.name: Southern-pine basement (memory)
set_pieces.camera: low-angle insert up at exposed pine joists, shallow focus, then match-cut back to the night sky

set_pieces.name: Universes and blessings
set_pieces.camera: slow push-in on POET's face as galaxies are placed in his hands; crowd of ancestors soft behind

set_pieces.name: Blood through the hands
set_pieces.line: their blood flows through my hands
set_pieces.camera: extreme close-up of palms and fingerprints lit by star-glow, rack focus to the ancestors

set_pieces.name: Baritone and warning
set_pieces.line: deepening my voice to a baritone of a million cries
set_pieces.camera: low-angle hero medium, POET turning out of frame toward the gate light

poems.title: Resurrecting Atlantis
poems.note: Palacio de Bellas Artes — winged marble: the Light Gates; then Madero, the narrow streets

set_pieces.name: The Light Gates open
set_pieces.camera: low wide on the gates opening, POET entering frame from behind camera; reverse to the city glowing through

set_pieces.name: Road down, following comets
set_pieces.camera: drone or crane following POET down the processional road, tilt up to comet streaks

set_pieces.name: The city rises / here we are all one
set_pieces.camera: extreme wide establishing as the city lifts, cut to POET in the gathering, faces lit from above

set_pieces.name: Jungle Interface and the heart-scan admission
set_pieces.line: the pact we've made here with nature
set_pieces.camera: handheld walk-through of vines on stone; insert of the heart-scan gate reading POET's chest

set_pieces.name: City Center: all safe
set_pieces.line: But here we are all safe
set_pieces.camera: slow 360 orbit around POET in the plaza

set_pieces.name: Narrow streets by candlelight
set_pieces.camera: Steadicam behind POET down the alley (never a face-on EX; none present), candle close-ups, window POVs

set_pieces.name: Could stay forever, then wandering to the house
set_pieces.camera: seated medium then wide; later documentary-style wandering (Mexico City footage) ending on a doorway with people filing in

poems.title: DJ Turn Me Up

set_pieces.name: DJ drops in
set_pieces.camera: whip-pan to the booth, insert on the fader, wide of the hushed room

set_pieces.name: Eyes wide shut at the mic
set_pieces.camera: tight profile close-up at the mic, slow push; reverse onto faces in the crowd

set_pieces.name: Ghosts in the speaker mesh
set_pieces.camera: macro on speaker mesh with superimposed silhouettes; cutaways to crowd watching

set_pieces.name: A thousand light years, into the red
set_pieces.camera: cut from galactic insert to VU meter close-up, then low angle on POET as the volume jumps

set_pieces.name: Wedding bands and the boxed home
set_pieces.camera: projected inserts on the wall behind the POET; crowd silhouettes in the foreground

set_pieces.name: Eleven years in daisy petals
set_pieces.camera: overhead on the platter, petals under the needle; cut to the empty space beside POET

set_pieces.name: Rain, fog, dim lights, then chin high
set_pieces.camera: wide of the floor in haze with the cloud practical overhead; end on a low-angle close-up, POET's chin raised into the spotlight

poems.title: Newly Single
poems.note: Torre Latinoamericana — the rooftop over Atlantis

set_pieces.name: The soul leaves the dancer
set_pieces.camera: medium on the dancer under strobe, then a slow crane up following the soul out of frame

set_pieces.name: Strangers collide; the last one to leave
set_pieces.camera: overhead slow-motion panorama (soul POV), then a 360 orbit around the lone dancer as the floor thins

set_pieces.name: Soul over Atlantis / the open field at the equator
set_pieces.line: Now let us put my soul
set_pieces.camera: top-down aerial of the lit city, match-cut to an extreme wide of a curved-horizon prairie with a gas giant in the sky

set_pieces.name: Angels' ice-water baptism
set_pieces.camera: high angle looking down the water's arc in slow motion; tight on the face as it hits

set_pieces.name: Haze and the soul's return
set_pieces.camera: push-in to the chest as the soul re-enters; side light through fog beams

set_pieces.name: Mountains from the rooftop
set_pieces.camera: over-the-shoulder at the parapet, long lens compressing the ridgeline under a crescent moon

set_pieces.name: Walking toward the moon

set_pieces.name: Suitcases at the phone booth
set_pieces.camera: low shot at suitcase level, booth light spilling on the curb; EX present only as hands and back

set_pieces.name: The call to Mother
set_pieces.camera: through the booth glass with the break-up on the sidewalk behind; in the living room, a window frame holding the sidewalk scene (window inferred)

set_pieces.name: Mounting the machine

set_pieces.name: Loneliness through midnight intersections

set_pieces.name: Swagger down the avenue

poems.title: New Day
poems.note: Rash Field — open ground on the harbor shore: the temple rises here

set_pieces.name: Arrival on the chilly shore
set_pieces.line: Even here is chilly in the morning.
set_pieces.camera: extreme wide from the water looking inland, bike small against the hills; slow push

set_pieces.name: Remnants in the sunlight
set_pieces.line: All the remnants of the destruction revealed in the sunlight.
set_pieces.camera: low macro dolly across debris as light rakes across it; sun flare

set_pieces.name: The temple builds itself
set_pieces.camera: locked-off time-lapse wide plus a tracking medium on the POET as walls assemble around him

set_pieces.name: Choir chords in the new nave (inferred)
set_pieces.line: choir chords calm the nerves of things I can't control
set_pieces.camera: symmetrical wide down the nave; sunbeam shafts; slow crane up

set_pieces.name: Journal and the lonely mirror (inferred)
set_pieces.line: I can close a chapter and open a journal stored away
set_pieces.camera: close-up on pages and his profile; over-shoulder into a mirror

set_pieces.name: Welcoming the new day
set_pieces.line: We can embrace a new day.
set_pieces.camera: reverse from inside the doors out to the sea, then wide exterior hero shot of the white temple

poems.title: Reunion
poems.note: Federal Hill Park — the meadow, the forest edge, the porch lights below

set_pieces.name: Welcome home in the hall
set_pieces.camera: wide master from the rafters, then handheld into the hugging circle

set_pieces.name: Loud voices, overheard hearts
set_pieces.line: loud voices so our hearts can be overheard
set_pieces.camera: tight chest-height mediums, shallow focus, fast cuts on laughter

set_pieces.name: The empty rooms of the afterlife
set_pieces.line: My mind drifts into the darkness of our afterlives
set_pieces.camera: tilt up into dim rafters; static wide of the dusty backroom

set_pieces.name: Hourglasses and the group photo (archival reenactment)
set_pieces.camera: locked frontal group tableau matched to the archival photo; macro on falling grains

set_pieces.name: Trees at the forest edge
set_pieces.line: grateful to every living tree in the forest
set_pieces.camera: low angle up into the canopy; slow lateral track along the trunks

set_pieces.name: Brotherhood chain
set_pieces.camera: profile tracking shot down the listening chain; extreme close-up of an ear on a chest

set_pieces.name: Football in the meadow, then home
set_pieces.line: follow paths of hilltops and canyons
set_pieces.camera: wide golden-hour meadow with the ball arcing through frame; closing shot from behind the group toward a lit porch

poems.title: How to Win My Heart
poems.note: Thames St at Broadway — the corner café at the Harbor of the Heavens

set_pieces.name: Walk from the temple around the harbor
set_pieces.line: with every pulsing beat after walking alone
set_pieces.camera: long lens lateral track along the promenade, water and boats between camera and POET

set_pieces.name: The corner cafe table
set_pieces.line: I want you to notice me in a corner cafe
set_pieces.camera: static medium on the POET at the corner table, couples soft in the foreground; eyeline cuts to the tables

set_pieces.name: Distances, younger selves, praying elders
set_pieces.line: with the distances we couldn't avoid
set_pieces.camera: reflections in the cafe window double his face with the ghost children; quiet wide in a church pew for the elders

set_pieces.name: Victory-less seasons (inner montage)
set_pieces.line: I've journeyed beyond any place you can conceivably be
set_pieces.camera: push in on his still face, then match-cuts into the montage

set_pieces.name: Harvesting the poppies
set_pieces.camera: aerial over flower fields; light flowing into his chest in a close-up

set_pieces.name: From a distant window
set_pieces.line: Yet from a distant window, beautiful and calm
set_pieces.camera: through-the-glass shot from outside the cafe; rack focus from reflection to his eyes; iris close-up

set_pieces.name: Stands and walks the harbor
set_pieces.line: all the fatigue of wandering alone in thought
set_pieces.camera: follow from behind along the waterline; widen as haze rises off the water

poems.title: Hot Minute
poems.note: The Belvedere, 1 E Chase St (1903) — the ballroom behind the old door

set_pieces.name: Taken by the haze
set_pieces.line: Don't make me leave and go where promises, hearts,
set_pieces.camera: slow tilt up the body as haze climbs; hand gripping a frame edge in close-up

set_pieces.name: Floating in the black
set_pieces.line: I escaped here for a reason
set_pieces.camera: static frame with the POET slowly rotating in black; frame cracks on 'terminated'

set_pieces.name: Cross-cut: highs and lows of life
set_pieces.line: let it feel love and lost as we must endure
set_pieces.camera: hard cuts on the beat between void and documentary B-roll

set_pieces.name: Battle scars and graytones
set_pieces.line: can't leave behind the impulse that comes from battle scars
set_pieces.camera: macro along skin and scars; desaturating grade

set_pieces.name: The vintage door appears
set_pieces.line: I trust that you'll be fine.
set_pieces.camera: wide of the lone door in black, POET entering frame from behind

set_pieces.name: The dance at the vintage party
set_pieces.line: Our dance together is a victory to entwine muses
set_pieces.camera: Steadicam following through the slow-motion crowd from behind; overhead on two dancers under one spotlight

set_pieces.name: Disappears into the crowd; door closes
set_pieces.line: and a genesis of a New Testament as it ends.
set_pieces.camera: hold on the back of the crowd as he vanishes; reverse from the void as the door swings shut to black
